text:
Maya Chen: quick heads-up — on the renewal call this morning Marina Corp signaled they want to add 3 new product teams next week (search, summarization, and a doc-ingest pipeline). Jorge said expected steady-state QPS could rise ~3-4x. Can we triage risk and next steps?

Jorge Alvarez: confirmed. Their PM said execs want predictable p95 latency <300ms for search routes before committing to the expansion. Also asked for per-route cost breakdown for finance during renewal discussion in ~6 weeks.

Sam Park: noted. I pulled current prod qps metrics — baseline ~120 qps avg, 200 p95 during spikes. If they add 3 teams with similar load, rough estimate 400–500 qps. Need to decide Dedicated vs burst policy. @Priya Nair can you validate if our current kernels handle that without perf regression?

Priya Nair: I can run a focused perf baseline on the search model in staging. Quick suggestion: enable KV prefix caching and try 4-bit quantization profile; that usually gives 2–3x token throughput with small quality tradeoffs. Will run tests and share numbers in ~48 hours.

Maya Chen: also asked for an enablement session for their infra + SRE teams (30 min) and a short runbook for failover. I can coordinate scheduling.

Sam Park: I'll draft a canary rollout plan (per-route traffic % over a week) and capacity estimate for Dedicated pods + burst. Will include cost delta for finance.

redwood-billing-bot: projection placeholder — estimated incremental monthly spend: +$12k–$20k (depends on batching/caching). Update after Sam's capacity numbers.

Jorge Alvarez: one more piece of feedback from the PM — search hits are noisy on long docs; they want reranker tuning or a lightweight rerank step. I told them we'd collect examples and run a quick eval.

Priya Nair: send 10 noisy examples and some expected behavior notes, I will run evals and propose reranker hyperparams / thresholds. Also will test quantized model to confirm no major regressions.

Maya Chen: OK action items and owners: Jorge -> collect examples + share with Priya (EOD), Sam -> capacity estimate + canary plan (48h), Priya -> perf baseline + reranker proposals (48h), Maya -> schedule enablement + update renewal brief (tomorrow AM).

Sam Park: noted, I'll include per-route token/cost breakdown and a short section on SLA risk mitigations.

Jorge Alvarez: examples uploaded to the shared folder: https://redwood.example.com/drive/marina_examples (I added short annotations).

Priya Nair: got it, starting evals now. Will post a short results blurb here when done.

Maya Chen: thanks everyone. I'll flag this account as expansion-risk-high in the tracker until we have the capacity + perf commitments. :thumbsup:
